description: Derived symbols (supplied per-row values such as column sums, carries, digit pairs) plus a switch (one fitted map per value of a symbol), from the 2026-11-02 compiled-state / forecast-cost Part D-E arc. MEASURED (3-digit addition, Qwen2.5-1.5B, single seed): F4 at L28 without switch 0.40 agreement; F4 carry-switched at L28 with zero transformer layers 0.976-0.978 (job-008821c65712; mdb reproduction job-5ac69ae2b1d4). Counter-evidence: carry keys add nothing at L<=24 (FINDINGS-D:102-105); column sums/pairs help only at L20 (+0.6-0.8 pp); a plain column-total feature reached the same 0.976 without a switch, so the gain may be the derived symbol rather than switching (symbol-table additions review 2026-11-14). Not in today's mdb symbols.py; the symbol-table builder adds derived-label columns and a switch group-by.
follow_up: Worth investigating WHICH LAYERS the derived symbols / switch help (a per-layer ladder of agreement with and without each derived symbol and with and without the switch, L16-L28), and working out the math behind it: why a switch is needed only where a linear map cannot express the composed digit, and whether the derived column is equivalent to adding the right nonlinear feature (gate-curvature view from the 2026-11-14 hop-math memo). Then test the cheap generalisation on the two-hop chain: hop-2 readout switched on the cell's decoded country.

description: Owner hypothesis (from the reasoning work): smarter models do the correct operation but sometimes on the wrong node, then retrace and pick the right node; more parameters mainly buy more ability to go back and forth and choose the right node. Related measurements: on small models deep-chain errors are mostly wrong-operand at the carrier, while on 3B/4B they are mostly right-operand-wrong-downstream (hop-math memo 2026-11-14 section 3, from per-item records); Qwen3-4B shows a re-read term 0.33 in the hop-2 ladder and a 3.8x super-linear re-read dose response ('source switching'); the content strip shows candidates changing across the L17-21 write window. Test: per layer and per row, track the candidate ranking (countries) in the carrier write and at the answer row, count node switches and corrections, and compare across sizes; for CoT models, also count written node corrections in reasoning traces and align them with the internal switches.
follow_up: 2026-11-14 exploratory pass (6 models, not preregistered, unaudited): per-layer country argmax at the carrier cell flips on nearly every layer, so carrier-cell flips are uninformative. At the answer row, wrong items switch candidates more and settle later on Qwen3-1.7B (2.1 vs 1.2, permutation p=0.001, holds within depth block); 4B gap (2.3 vs 1.6) NOT significant (p=0.15, depth-block confound) per audit AUDIT-HOPMATH.md; no gap on Qwen2.5; no size trend. retrace.py saves no margins, so near-tie flips are untested. Hypothesis neither supported nor refuted. Next: count switches only above a margin floor (ignore near-ties), separate wrong-to-right corrections from churn, and run the CoT version (written node corrections in R1-Distill traces aligned with answer-row switches).

description: Where does a wrong operand come from? On wrong d3/d4 items, watch the carrier cell's country content L0-L20, find the first layer where it goes wrong, back-trace to the head/MLP whose write flipped it, and decompose that write into SAE/transcoder features.

Retrace at the answer row with margins: watch the candidate-set argmax and its margin per layer, attribute each switch with hop_edge, separate wrong-to-right corrections from near-tie churn. Successor to the exploratory retrace pass (node-selection-and-retrace-with-scale).

Do keys decide copy vs hop? Hold donor V vs donor K separately at the carrier and its readers (entry 1: K+V gives the donor's capital on 11/12 pairs where V alone copies the entity). Needs holds (audit P4).
How do answer-row MLPs compose hop 2 and 3? Decompose MLP writes into transcoder features, hold the country feature fixed, vary the relation (capital vs language).
Seal mdb's linear forecast and nnsight's gradient forecast side by side, verify natively; sites where both miss are the model's nonlinear switches (cf. hop-math gate curvature 0.87).
When does the carrier's country feature first appear and who writes it? Feature lineage strips beside per-layer liveness; trace the first active layer back to its heads.
